_why: NIGHT33 builder R (design.n33.kit33 swaps n32-iceline for this file): Tools/night/gen-n33-iceline.cjs = gen-n32-iceline.cjs. NIGHT32 builder A (design.n32.arenas32 swaps n30-iceline for this file): Tools/night/gen-n32-iceline.cjs = gen-n30-iceline.cjs with i6 FIGURE EIGHT rebuilt and i6b SKATE RING inserted (new). LEVEL 2, THE ICE LINE (NIGHT29, builder R, DESIGN29.md section D; GG: 'there needs to be more level before it to teach you the ice mechanic', 'a tank enemy that can be one shot by the fists', 'like speed skating ... you snap on to it ... use your ground dash'). Pistol, fist and PULSE gauntlet only (the shotgun is level 3's award); no weapon is awarded. i1 the TANK corridor (6 light husks in front of a coloured tank: the tank dies to one gauntlet hit, the pistol does x0.15), i2 the PULSE room (five kills, LT launches over a gap), i3 rest with the first ice sheen, i4 the first SKATE LANE (one ice lane over a pit on both sides, a lip at its end), i5 two lanes (a dash sideways between them, a husk wave on the far bank), i6 the ice fight (two tanks, ten husks, banks), i7 rest, g1 THE RINK (the Glacier's room: a boss room; the fight is builder B's rink map). Ice is level data: `surfaces` rows kind ice (the sim's Surface26) with a `lane` block (axis, line) for builder B's SKATE LANE rule. A tank is enemy kind `tank` (builder S). Pars: i1 is the bot's median over 10 seeds, the rest are estimates (see Tools/night/n29-pars.json). Generated by Tools/night/gen-n30-iceline.cjs through n29-lib.cjs. Web coordinates, metres: x east, y up, z SOUTH.
